name: Cellecor Gadgets Ltd.
summary: Cellecor Gadgets Ltd. operates as an electronics distribution firm, specializing in a diverse range of devices such as mobile phones, televisions, radio receivers, and audio/video recording and playback equipment, alongside associated merchandise. Established in 2011 by Ravi Agarwal and Nikhil Agarwal, the company's main operations are based in New Delhi, India.
